summary: The PR addresses an inconsistency between fit_predict and predict methods in GaussianMixture when n_init > 1. However, the change is redundant and does not improve the functionality.

issues.description: The change is non-minimal as it moves the same code block without altering its logic, which does not resolve the underlying issue.
There are no additional tests added to verify the fix for the described issue, only the existing test is modified to include n_init.
